description: Create a new stage for an API in an API Gateway product. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

apiId.description: API ID to create the stage for

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the stage

endpointDomain.description: Backend endpoint domain for the stage, e.g. https://backend.example.com (required)

ipAclCode.description: IP ACL mode; required together with ipAclList

ipAclList.description: IP ACL list; required together with ipAclCode

productId.description: Product ID the API belongs to

response.description: Response body for the maintenance status code (0-1500 chars)

stageName.description: Name for the new stage (1-20 chars: letters, digits, '-', '_')

statusCode.description: Status code returned while in maintenance (100-599)

name: ncloud_apigw_create_stage
